description: No rig at all: the subject is lit only by what the world itself holds - its street lamps, lit windows, sky and whatever stray light reaches it - the way a car parked on a real street at night is. Highlights fall where the lamps put them, uneven and partial, and panels facing away fall into near-black; there is no key, no rim, no fill, no reflection card. exposure meters the whole frame like a camera; straySpill is the share of a nearby lamp that leaks through the side glass onto part of the cabin (0 = none). The night street's documentary light.
